sloka: सा त्वम् धर्म परा नित्यम् दृष्ट लोक पर अवर ।न अर्हसे विप्रियम् वक्तुम् दुह्खिता अपि सुदुह्खितम् ॥२-६२-९॥
transliteration: sā tvam dharma parā nityam dṛṣṭa loka para avara ।na arhase vipriyam vaktum duhkhitā api suduhkhitam ॥2-62-9॥

translations.english: You always adhere to righteousness. You have seen both the extremes (good and bad) of this world. Athough you yourself are in grief it does not behove you to speak unpleasant words to one who is suffering from a greater grief.
